Foxconn Industrial Internet Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Shenzhen, China.

selected.text: Britain's Tesco raises profit outlook after strong summer

Britain's Tesco raises profit outlook after strong summer
STORY: Tesco on Thursday raised its full-year profit forecast.Britain's biggest supermarket group said it benefited from an unusually hot summer and won market share from rivals.This year, its share of Britain's grocery market has grown this year to over 28%.And it now expects 2025/26 adjusted operating profit of between $3.9-$4.2 billion - up from previous guidance.UK like-for-like sales in the first half were up 4.9%, having been up 5.1% in the first quarter.It set aside cash to deal with a pledge of sustained price cuts from Asda, the number three player, which has been losing market share.However, no price war has materialized and Tesco's shares have risen 17% so far this year.Analysts say the supermarket’s strategy of matching the prices of discounter Aldi on over 600 items is driving growth.Along with heavy promotion of its Clubcard loyalty scheme, which provides lower prices for members.
